sloka: जाम्बवन्तं तु दशभिर्नीलं त्रिंशद्भिरेव च।सुग्रीवमृषभं चैव सो ऽङ्गदं द्विविदं तथा।घोरैर्दत्तवरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्निष्प्राणानकरोत्तदा ।। ६.७३.४४ ।।
transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ tu daśabhirnīlaṁ triṁśadbhireva ca।sugrīvamṛṣabhaṁ caiva so 'ṅgadaṁ dvividaṁ tathā।ghorairdattavaraistīkṣṇairniṣprāṇānakarottadā ।। 6.73.44 ।।

translations.english: Energetic Indrajith, who is ever victorious in battle dispersed the deadly rain of rocks and trees capable of taking out life.
